name: 基本 TM/EWM – 入库高级装运和收货 (7GP)
name_en: Basic TM/EWM – Inbound Advanced Shipping and Receiving (7GP)
description_en_html:
Overview

Advanced Shipping and Receiving is an integrated, end-to-end process that allows users to send, receive, and transport products. It helps you, to coordinate the process steps from arrival of trucks at the gate to the final goods receipt in the warehouse. A truck that has posted arrival at a checkpoint can carry out both loading and unloading activities at a location, or it can deliver goods at several warehouses at the same location.

This scope item describes a common inbound scenario for an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) ordering material from a supplier at different times during a certain time span. This scenario runs embedded in the OEM’s facilities with a basic Transportation Management license and an Extended Warehouse Management license.

Key Process Flow

  • Create Purchase Order
  • Create Inbound Delivery
  • Display Freight Unit
  • Display Warehouse Inbound Delivery
  • Creation of Freight Order
  • Transportation Planning
  • Transportation Execution
  • Unloading of Goods

Business Benefits

Advanced Shipping and Receiving simplifies communication between the Transportation Management (TM), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Inventory Management and Physical Inventory (MM-IM), and Logistics Execution (LE) application components embedded in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition. We need Materials Management (MM) and Sales and Distribution (SD) to create transportation requirements.
description_zh_html:
概览

高级装运和收货是一个集成的端到端流程，允许用户发送、接收和运输产品。它可以帮助您协调流程步骤，从货车到达门到仓库中的最终收货。已到达检查点的卡车可以在一个位置执行装货和卸货活动，也可以在同一位置的多个仓库交货。

此范围项目描述了原始设备制造商 (OEM) 在特定时间范围内的不同时间从供应商处订购物料的常见内向场景。此场景嵌入到具有基本运输管理许可和高级仓库管理许可的 OEM 设施中。

关键流程流

  • 创建采购订单
  • 创建入库交货
  • 显示货运单位
  • 显示仓库入库交货
  • 创建货运订单
  • 运输计划
  • 运输执行
  • 卸货

业务优势

高级装运和收货简化了 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中嵌入的运输管理 (TM)、高级仓库管理 (EWM)、库存管理和库存盘点 (MM-IM) 以及物流执行 (LE) 应用程序组件之间的通信。我们需要物料管理 (MM) 以及销售和分销 (SD) 来创建运输需求。
